Package chessgame.pieces

Class Piece

java.lang.Object
chessgame.pieces.Piece
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bishop, King, Knight, Pawn, Queen, Rook
public abstract class Piece extends Object
Abstract base class representing a generic chess piece.

This class uses a highly optimized memory footprint by storing all the piece's state (position, color, and movement history) within a single 8-bit byte.

    • Piece

      public Piece(byte row, byte col, boolean isWhite)
      Constructs a Piece with specified row, column, and color. * @param row The initial row position on the board (0-7).
      Parameters:
      col - The initial column position on the board (0-7).
      isWhite - True if the piece belongs to the white player, false if black.

    • Piece

      public Piece(int row, int col, boolean isWhite)
      Constructs a Piece using integer coordinates and color. This is a convenience constructor that casts the integers to bytes. * @param row The initial row position on the board (0-7).
      Parameters:
      col - The initial column position on the board (0-7).
      isWhite - True if the piece belongs to the white player, false if black.

    • Piece

      public Piece(byte pieceInfo)
      Constructs a Piece by directly assigning the packed info byte. * @param pieceInfo The byte containing the encoded state of the piece.

  • Method Details

    • getRow

      public byte getRow()
      Retrieves the row position of the piece from the bitfield. * @return The row position (0-7) extracted from the 3 least significant bits.

    • getCol

      public byte getCol()
      Retrieves the column position of the piece from the bitfield. * @return The column position (0-7) extracted from bits 3 to 5.

    • getPos

      public byte getPos()
      Retrieves the combined row and column position of the piece. * @return A byte representing the position (0-63) extracted from the 6 least significant bits.

      public byte getPieceInfo()
      Retrieves the raw packed byte containing the entire state of the piece. * @return The 8-bit piece information.
